C0322.title: Barracuda Warns of Surging Advanced OAuth Phishing Attacks Exploiting Protocol Flaws to Hijack Accounts
C0322.summary: A Barracuda monthly threat report said it observed several notable OAuth phishing threats. Attackers abused Microsoft OAuth authorization mechanisms by crafting malicious links that induced users to complete authorization flows, obtaining account access and potentially taking over accounts while bypassing traditional password-centric protections. Because this type of attack relies on user-granted authorization rather than direct password theft, organizations need to govern third-party app consent and token permissions.
